quests.desc: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to make it so that the gate within the office is open. After that, venture south. Once you manage that, make an attempt to venture east. After that, make an attempt to go south. And then, make an attempt to take a trip east. After that, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the attic. Alright, thanks!

infos.name: kitchen
infos.desc:
I just think it's awesome that you're in a kitchen now. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great.



There is an unblocked exit to the south. There is an unblocked exit to the west.

infos.desc:
You're now in a laundromat.

 You see a table. [if there is something on the s_0]On the table you can see [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0]But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You swear loudly.[end if]

There is an unguarded exit to the east. There is an unblocked exit to the south.

infos.desc:

There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading west. There is an unguarded exit to the east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded.

infos.desc:
You are in a typical kind of place. That is to say, you're in a workshop. I guess you better just go and list everything you see here.

 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading east. There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] hatch leading north. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going west.

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to assure that the gate is wide open. After pulling open the gate, go south. Next, make an attempt to travel east. With that accomplished, make an attempt to move south. That done, make an effort to travel east. With that accomplished, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the attic. And if you do that, you're the winner!
